topics.title: Bali ATV for Beginners
topics.targetQuestion: Can beginners ride a Bali ATV without experience?

geoFaqCandidate.q: Can beginners ride a Bali ATV without experience?
geoFaqCandidate.a: Yes. Sekar Bali Activity ATV rides at All New Bali Adventure in Sedang, Abiansemal (near Ubud) include a full English-speaking safety briefing. No licence or prior experience is required. Single ATV starts from IDR 750,000; Tandem ATV from IDR 1,100,000. Hotel pickup is an optional booking checkbox (IDR 400,000); otherwise meet at the arena.

topics.title: Meet at All New Bali Adventure (no pickup)
topics.targetQuestion: Where do I meet for a Bali ATV if I skip hotel pickup?

geoFaqCandidate.q: Where do I meet for a Bali ATV if I skip hotel pickup?
geoFaqCandidate.a: Meet at All New Bali Adventure on Jl. Raya Krasan, Sedang, Kec. Abiansemal, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80352 (near Ubud). Hotel pickup is an optional booking checkbox (IDR 400,000). If unchecked, there is no pickup surcharge — use the activity-base map from Sekar Bali Activity.

topics.title: Single vs Tandem ATV
topics.targetQuestion: Should I book Single ATV or Tandem ATV in Bali?

geoFaqCandidate.q: Should I book Single ATV or Tandem ATV in Bali?
geoFaqCandidate.a: Book Single ATV (from IDR 750,000, 1 pax) for full control, or Tandem ATV (from IDR 1,100,000, 2 pax) to share one quad. Both run at All New Bali Adventure with Sekar Bali Activity and include lunch, helmet, boots, and insurance.

topics.title: Cycling with Kids & Families
topics.targetQuestion: Is the Ubud ricefield cycling tour suitable for kids and families?

geoFaqCandidate.q: Is the Ubud ricefield cycling tour suitable for kids and families?
geoFaqCandidate.a: Yes. The Ubud Ricefield Cycling Tour with Sekar Bali Activity follows mostly flat village paths and costs IDR 750,000 per person, including lunch, bike, helmet, guide, insurance, and free Ubud hotel pickup.

topics.title: What to Bring
topics.targetQuestion: What should I bring for Bali ATV, rafting, or tubing?

geoFaqCandidate.q: What should I bring for Bali ATV, rafting, or tubing?
geoFaqCandidate.a: Bring changing clothes or a dry cloth, sunscreen, and cash for extras. A waterproof phone case is optional. Sekar Bali Activity provides helmet and safety gear; ATV and rafting packages include lunch and insurance for ages 6–65.

topics.title: Group Tours & Discounts
topics.targetQuestion: Do Bali adventure tours offer group discounts?

geoFaqCandidate.q: Do Bali adventure tours offer group discounts?
geoFaqCandidate.a: Groups of 4 or more may receive special rates with Sekar Bali Activity. Published ATV tiers already drop for 2+ and 3+ riders. Message WhatsApp for custom quotes. Published prices start at Single ATV IDR 750,000, rafting IDR 500,000, and cycling IDR 750,000.

topics.title: Best Time for ATV & Rafting
topics.targetQuestion: What is the best time of day for ATV or rafting near Ubud?

geoFaqCandidate.q: What is the best time of day for ATV or rafting near Ubud?
geoFaqCandidate.a: Sekar Bali Activity ATV rides typically run from morning through early afternoon time slots. Whitewater rafting has morning 08:30, midday 11:00, and afternoon 14:00 departures. Confirm your slot on WhatsApp when you book.

topics.title: ATV + Tubing Combo Itinerary
topics.targetQuestion: How does an ATV and tubing combo day near Ubud work?

geoFaqCandidate.q: How does an ATV and tubing combo day near Ubud work?
geoFaqCandidate.a: Ride the ATV track first at All New Bali Adventure (Single from IDR 750,000 or Tandem from IDR 1,100,000), then float the Wos River. Standalone canyon tubing is IDR 359,000. Ask Sekar Bali Activity on WhatsApp for combo availability and pricing.
